config_name: MacBook Pro 14-inch — M6 12-core CPU / 12-core GPU, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD, nano-texture glass

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: Up to 24h video / 16h web claimed; 72.4Wh. Nano-texture glass does not change runtime.

price.notes: Verified on apple.com/ca buy page; nano-texture option is +$225 over the $2,799 base (see research/parts/apple/NOTES.md).

reviews.quote: While the base MacBook Pro design is getting a bit tired, Apple's new M6 chip gives the 14-inch MacBook even more pep in its step.
great Mini-LED panel (with a matte option) (same chassis tested with nano-texture on the M5 Max model)

praises: Nano-texture matte glass kills reflections in bright studios and offices — NBC calls the matte option a big advantage over most rivals
Mini-LED XDR 120Hz panel remains best-in-class for laptops even in matte form (NBC)
M6 gives a solid year-over-year performance bump (Tom's Hardware)
Impeccable all-aluminum build and outstanding battery life (RTINGS)
Only $225 CAD extra — far cheaper than matte surcharges on Windows workstation panels
complaints: Nano-texture slightly reduces perceived sharpness/contrast vs glossy (common NBC matte-panel observation)
Memory and SSD upgrades on top of nano-texture stack up fast (Tom's Hardware con)
Same 5-year-old chassis; design is starting to look stale (Tom's Hardware con)
Only 3x Thunderbolt 4 on the M6 tier; TB5 reserved for Pro/Max
Special-order glass: nano-texture configs can backorder during launch and holiday seasons

design_philosophy: Apple's nano-texture glass etches the cover glass to scatter reflections while keeping the XDR Mini-LED's contrast — the option photographers and editors ask for by name. On the M6 base tier it is the cheapest way into a matte XDR MacBook Pro.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from tested M6 16/1TB config (Tom's 4.5/5): +0.5 readability_bright for matte nano-texture glass, −0.1 screen_quality for slight sharpness diffusion. NBC tested this chassis with the nano-texture option. Sentiment synthesized from pro reviews — Reddit API blocked (403). Identical internals to the Entry config; differs only by the +$225 nano-texture glass option.
